target_customer: Brick and mortar retailers, and shoppers looking for products in nearby stores
problem: Local stores lose sales to online retail because shoppers cannot see or buy their inventory online.
business_model: Ecommerce platform for local retail inventory (revenue model not found)

founders.name: Andii Davis
founders.background_notes: Name appears only on YC and the Altss directory.

technical_complexity.rationale: Syncing inventory from many small retailers' point of sale systems is integration heavy though not research grade.

defensibility.rationale: No data or contract lock-in was documented, and similar local inventory startups were being funded in the same period.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source describes an incumbent action against Rare Door; the cause of its inactivity is not public.

market_need_then: Local inventory startups such as Shoptiques (YC, backed by a16z and Greylock) were funded in this period, showing investor interest, but no Rare Door demand evidence was found.

branding.domain_note: raredoor.com now redirects to a domain sales page (HugeDomains), so the domain was released or sold after shutdown.

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand material was found.

outcome_analysis: Rare Door joined YC in Winter 2015 as a two person team building a marketplace for products in nearby stores, and is now marked inactive with its domain parked for sale. The cause of failure is not public, no funding or traction was found, and no post-mortem exists, so no failure factors can be assigned.
notes: Cause of shutdown is not public after a dedicated outcome search; failure_factors left empty for that reason. Shutdown date unknown. Founding year not sourced (YC batch Winter 2015). No funding press or aggregator entry found, so funding is none_found, not zero. Founder Andii Davis appears on one directory only. Competitor search returned only Shoptiques, which no source ties to Rare Door, so the list is empty. The redirect target is a domain broker, not fetched.
